title: A Day in Town
text:
This is my town. There is a big park near my house. The park has many trees and a small lake. Children play there every day.

Next to the park is a library. My mother goes there on Saturdays to read books. Across the street is a bakery with fresh bread.

questions.text: What is near the speaker's house?
Where does the speaker's mother go on Saturdays?
Why are the children probably happy at the park?
options: Because they have to read books
Because they have to work there

questions.text: What can we infer about the speaker's mother?

vocabulary.definition: a public green area with trees where people can walk and play
a place where people can borrow and read books
a shop that sells bread and cakes
a large area of water surrounded by land

paragraph_translations: Це моє місто. Біля мого дому є великий парк. У парку багато дерев і невелике озеро. Діти там гуляють щодня.
Поруч із парком є бібліотека. Моя мама ходить туди по суботах, щоб читати книжки. Через вулицю є пекарня зі свіжим хлібом.
